Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1250350. Join activities to assays for assay_chembl_id, to target_dictionary for target_type and tax_id, to molecule_dictionary for molecule_chembl_id, and INNER JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value not null. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
